title: All service routes still render static fallback templates because no servicePage docs are present
evidence: Route wrapper returns static page when servicePage is null (src/app/(site)/(pages)/seo-services/page.tsx:13-17; same pattern in all 8 service route files). Runtime Playwright checks showed isCmsTemplate=false and static home IDs=true for all 8 service routes.
impact: Service hero/solution/process/stories copy remains hardcoded and non-editable in Sanity.
recommended_fix: Create servicePage documents for all 8 slugs and add a runtime guard/healthcheck to catch missing documents.

title: Partnership page still serves static fallback instead of CMS page
evidence: Partnership route returns <PartnershipPage /> when CMS doc is absent (src/app/(site)/(pages)/partnership/page.tsx:10-14). Runtime check: hasCmsSection=false, hasStaticSection=true.
impact: Major business page content is not editable in CMS.
recommended_fix: Seed partnershipPage singleton in Sanity and enforce non-null fetch in production.

title: Case studies index is hardcoded-first and title-merged, so new CMS case studies can be omitted
evidence: Hardcoded CASE_STUDY_CARDS list drives rendering (src/components/pages/case-studies/case-studies-page.tsx:27-95). CMS data is merged by title key (src/components/pages/case-studies/case-studies-page.tsx:154-168) and unmatched cards keep fallback href values.
impact: Renamed/new case studies in Sanity can be invisible or improperly linked.
recommended_fix: Render directly from CMS collection and only use static fallback when CMS collection is empty.

title: Case study detail route does not render body and misreads SEO fields
evidence: CASE_STUDY_BY_SLUG_QUERY returns body + seo (src/sanity/lib/queries.ts:56-69). Route reads caseStudy.seo.title/description (src/app/(site)/(pages)/case-studies/[slug]/page.tsx:80-83) although schema uses seo.metaTitle/metaDescription. No caseStudy.body rendering exists in this component.
impact: Full case-study narrative and CMS SEO metadata are not published as expected.
recommended_fix: Render body via PortableText and map SEO from metaTitle/metaDescription.

title: Insights static params and sitemap still depend on static registries instead of CMS slugs
evidence: generateStaticParams uses BLOG_POSTS (src/app/(site)/(pages)/insights/[slug]/page.tsx:49). sitemap uses PUBLISHED_INSIGHTS registry (src/app/sitemap.ts:3, src/app/sitemap.ts:26).
impact: CMS slugs can be missing from static generation and sitemap discovery.
recommended_fix: Drive both static params and sitemap from Sanity slug queries.

title: siteSettings document is absent at runtime, so global nav/footer surfaces fall back to hardcoded defaults
evidence: Layout fetches getSiteSettings() (src/app/(site)/layout.tsx:43-46), but navbar/footer fallback constants are used when props are missing (src/components/layout/navbar.tsx:10-37; src/components/layout/footer.tsx:6-59). Sanity runtime count query returned siteSettings: 0.
impact: Global links/contact/social values are not CMS-controlled.
recommended_fix: Seed mandatory siteSettings singleton and add startup validation when absent.

title: Home team hash path for Anastasija resolves to no popup
evidence: Home links to /about-us#anastasija-jankovic (src/components/sections/team.tsx:19-25). Popup creation requires populated popup fields (src/components/sections/about-us-team.tsx:81-89), and fallback POPUP_DATA only includes Nebojša (src/components/sections/about-us-team-data.ts:55-78). Runtime check: /about-us#anastasija-jankovic opens no dialog.
impact: User clicks a profile CTA and lands without expected profile modal.
recommended_fix: Either ensure popup data exists for linked members or remove unsupported hash links from Home team section.

title: Global contact and navbar CTA values are still hardcoded in UI
evidence: Mobile phone links are hardcoded tel:+13073367191 (src/components/layout/mobile-menu.tsx:123, src/components/layout/mobile-menu.tsx:174). Navbar CTA label/url are hardcoded (src/components/layout/navbar.tsx:79-86).
impact: Business contact channels and top CTA require code changes instead of CMS edits.
recommended_fix: Extend site settings schema/query for header phone and navbar CTA label/url and wire both desktop/mobile components.

title: Footer CTA destination URL is hardcoded to /contact
evidence: Footer CTA href is fixed to /contact (src/components/layout/footer-cta-variant.tsx:215) while only heading/body/label are CMS-backed. siteSettings schema has no footer CTA URL field (src/sanity/schemaTypes/documents/siteSettings.ts:125-140).
impact: Editors cannot retarget the most prominent footer CTA.
recommended_fix: Add footerCtaUrl to siteSettings schema/query and consume it in FooterCtaVariant.

title: Contact and privacy routes currently render hardcoded fallback content
evidence: Contact defaults to fallback heading/intro/email when cmsPage is null (src/components/pages/contact/contact-page.tsx:20-25). Privacy page uses hardcoded legal sections when cmsPage.body is missing (src/components/pages/privacy-policy/privacy-policy-page.tsx:40-71). Runtime checks confirmed default heading and fallback legal sections.
impact: Legal and contact copy are not reliably editable in Sanity.
recommended_fix: Create contactPage/legalPage docs and treat missing docs as configuration errors in production.

title: Service icon fields are modeled and rendered as text strings instead of media
evidence:
serviceCard.iconSrc and whyChooseItem.iconSrc are string fields (src/sanity/schemaTypes/documents/servicePage.ts:114-118, src/sanity/schemaTypes/documents/servicePage.ts:179-182). CmsServicePage renders these values in

text nodes (src/components/pages/shared/cms-service-page.tsx:91-95, src/components/pages/shared/cms-service-page.tsx:163-166).
impact: Editors entering icon paths will produce text output, not icons.
recommended_fix: Switch icon fields to image/file references or render iconSrc as images if path strings are intentionally used.

title: No dedicated team member detail route exists despite teamMember slug support
evidence: Team schema defines slug (src/sanity/schemaTypes/documents/teamMember.ts:15-19), but route inventory under src/app/(site)/(pages) has no /team/[slug] or /about-us/[slug] page.
impact: No canonical/indexable/shareable profile pages for team members.
recommended_fix: Add a dynamic team-member route or remove slug expectations from CMS and UX.
